about_the_game:
In Hallowed Faces, you return to your village at dusk after spending the entire afternoon collecting berries deep in the woods. Darkness has already fallen, and the wind has picked up. A cold mist blankets the streets, and the village that should be bustling with evening life is silent. The familiar wooden homes stand dark and empty. The only movement comes from the window shutters and the street lanterns. An eerie feeling settles over you, as though the village itself is watching, holding its breath, waiting for you to uncover what’s lurking in the fog.

Key features

  • Halloween Atmosphere – Wander between the fog-covered woods and the quiet village streets. Carve pumpkins, cross paths with a mysterious witch, and uncover what this haunted night truly hides.

  • Rich Lore – Uncover the dark history of the valley and the haunting secrets its people tried to bury.

  • Full Voice Acting – Immerse yourself in chilling performances that bring everything to life.

  • Unsettling Events – Experience unpredictable, spine-chilling moments that keep you questioning what’s real.

  • Puzzles & Riddles – Solve eerie mysteries and uncover clues to piece together the truth behind the fog.

  • Hidden Secrets – Keep your eyes open for cryptic notes, subtle hints, and eerie Easter eggs scattered throughout the village.

  • Multiple Endings – Your choices matter. Each decision leads you closer to salvation… or something far worse.

  • Compact Horror Experience – 30–45 minutes of tension, mystery, and dread. Perfect for a chilling night in.

short_description: Returning to the village feels wrong. The wind howls through empty streets, and the lanterns sway like they’re alive. What happened while you were gone?
